research_notes: Name and sector: PT Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur Tbk (unchanged legal name; FS2025 and 9M2026 FS cover pages), 80.53% owned by PT Indofood Sukses Makmur Tbk (INDF, which consolidates ICBP). Subsector food: instant noodles (about 75% of sales; FS2025 segment note PDF p. 105), dairy, snack foods, food seasonings, nutrition & special foods, beverages, packaging. IDR reporter: FS 'Disajikan dalam Jutaan Rupiah'; money here = Rp juta / 1,000 (IDR billion), kept exact.

Source policy: every FY level comes from that year's own audited consolidated FS (all downloaded from www.indofoodcbp.com/uploads/statement/; FS2019 and FS2020 are still served there though no longer linked). EBITDA, ROE, ROA and year-end prices from that year's own annual report (Financial Highlights PDF p. 8; Share Price Information PDF p. 21). Payout ratios from the next year's AR (FY2020-FY2024) and the IR dividend page (FY2025). Dividend schedules from the company's AGM resolution summaries (FY2021-FY2025) and the KSEI notice (FY2020); dividend totals from the next year's FS Note 22. No news, aggregator or wiki source was used.

Restatement: FS2022 (Note 4, PDF p. 77-78) restated FY2021 and 1 Jan 2021 for the updated interpretation of PSAK 24 (attributing employee benefits to periods of service). The file keeps the ORIGINALLY reported FY2020/FY2021 figures from FS2020/FS2021. Restated FY2021 (FS2022 PDF p. 13-17, AR2022-AR2025 highlights): total assets 118,015.311, total liabilities 63,074.704, equity attributable 34,090.000, total equity 54,940.607, net profit attributable 6,399.431, EPS 549, gross profit 20,287.284, income from operations 11,673.607, EBITDA 13,306.0. Restated 31 Dec 2020: total assets 103,502.626, equity attributable 29,758.283, total equity 50,659.843. All differences are below 1% (largest: equity attributable +0.6%); a reviewer may prefer the restated FY2021 set.

Pinehill acquisition (not a corporate action under the schema): on 27 Aug 2020 ICBP completed the purchase of 100% of Pinehill Company Limited (PCL, BVI holding company of the Indomie producers in Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Kenya, Morocco, Serbia and Turkey, which PCL owns 47-59%, FS2020 PDF p. 17-18) for US$2,998 mn (FS2020 Note 1, PDF p. 17-26). It explains the FY2020 jump in total assets (38.7 -> 103.6 trn; goodwill 54.0 trn), NCI (1.4 -> 20.9 trn) and debt (bridge bank loans 30.8 trn, refinanced in 2021 by US$2.75 bn of US-dollar bonds due 2031/2032/2051/2052). A US$650 mn retention amount was carried as 'other long-term liability' (2020) / 'other short-term liability' (2021) and paid in 2022; it is not a borrowing and is excluded from total_debt.

total_debt = short-term bank loans/overdrafts/trust receipts + current and non-current bank loans + bonds payable + other long-term debt (an interest-bearing Rupiah loan to subsidiary TSP, FS2021 Note 17c), excluding lease liabilities. For every year the sum equals the AR's printed 'Funded Debt / Pinjaman yang Dikenakan Bunga' (2019 2,356.2; 2020 31,505.8; 2021 41,576.0; 2022 45,837.4; 2023 43,761.6; 2024 45,420.2; 2025 47,186.4).

EBITDA: ICBP prints EBITDA only in the AR Financial Highlights table (no definition; EBIT = income from operations). Interim EBITDA is not published (9M2026 FS and results release checked), so ebitda_ytd/_prior are null.

ROE/ROA are the AR's own ratios, which use income for the year INCLUDING non-controlling interests over average total equity (incl. NCI) / average total assets (verified for FY2020 and FY2025). They are not owners-only returns; the site computes its own ROE from net_profit_attr and equity_attr.

Corporate actions: none since 2019-01-01. The company's share-listing chronology (AR2025 PDF p. 20; IR page /page/chronological-shares-listing-at-idx) lists only the Oct-2010 IPO (5,830,954,000 shares) and the 27 Jul 2016 par split Rp100 -> Rp50 (1:2) to 11,661,908,000 shares; every FS from 2019 to 9M2026 shows 11,661,908,000 issued shares and no treasury shares. No rights or bonus issue, so no FY2019 year-end price is stored. No corporate_actions key in this file.

Dividends: one final cash dividend per year, no interim dividends (IR dividend page lists one payment per FY). DPS 215 (FY2020), 215 (FY2021), 188 (FY2022), 200 (FY2023), 250 (FY2024), 265 (FY2025); totals are the Rp juta amounts in the next year's FS Note 22 (FY2020 total also stated as Rp2,507,310,220,000 in the AGM resolution, AR2021 PDF p. 106).

9M2026: profit attributable fell 13% (6,165.9 vs 7,108.2 bn) on higher finance expenses (net forex loss from financing activities 3,345.3 vs 1,433.2 bn, 9M2026 FS Note 30), while net sales rose 15% and income from operations 7%. The 'other long-term debt' 8,753 moved to current maturities at 30 Sep 2026 and is still included in total_debt.

Access: www.indofoodcbp.com serves an incomplete TLS chain (no intermediate certificate), so curl fails verification. The missing DigiCert intermediate (DigiCert Global G2 TLS RSA SHA256 2020 CA1) was downloaded from DigiCert's own AIA URL and added to a CA bundle so the chain verified normally (scripts/ca/). This is ordinary chain completion, not a bot-protection bypass; the site has no bot challenge. KSEI notice fetched directly from web.ksei.co.id.
